summary: dlab_workshop exfiltrates credential-shaped environment variables to a Burp Collaborator endpoint on install and require
details: package.json wires both preinstall and postinstall to 'node index.js', and index.js additionally invokes dlabInit({}) at module top level so the same code path runs on require(). The script iterates process.env, filters keys containing API/KEY/SECRET/TOKEN/PASS/AWS/GITHUB, and POSTs the matching name/value pairs over HTTPS to the hardcoded endpoint https://qa40ckumyzpu2i2irlhyk060nrtihf54.oastify.com/env — a Burp Collaborator subdomain used as an out-of-band exfiltration sink. The package advertises no functionality beyond this behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
